capabilities.justification: The gem's lib code require's the matrix_rust_ruby_native .{so,bundle,dll} (built from the workspace Rust crate at code/packages/rust/matrix-rust-ruby-native/) to get MatrixRustRuby.run_graph_on_cpu. That native ext itself delegates to c-bridge's pure-Rust envelope runner.

extconf.rb and the Rakefile compile task shell out to `cargo` to build the workspace Rust crate. The cargo command is constructed from hardcoded literals + RbConfig-discovered values (host_os, host_cpu); no user input is interpolated into the argv.

justification: Pure-Ruby gem on top of a Rust native extension. No network, no filesystem reads outside the gem's own directories, no user-controlled command execution. The single FFI surface is one Ruby method (MatrixRustRuby.run_graph_on_cpu) that takes a JSON envelope String and returns a JSON envelope String.
